tools.name: software-security_sbom-vulnerability-match
tools.description: Parse a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM, or a component list, and classify each exact package version against OSV advisories as affected, unaffected, or unknown. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/software-security/sbom-vulnerability-match Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security advisory, packa

tools.name: software-security_dependency-risk-report
tools.description: Summarise affected, unaffected, and unknown OSV advisory counts for each exact dependency version. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/software-security/dependency-risk-report Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security advisory, package audit, lockfile audit, dependency check, CycloneDX, S

tools.name: software-security_kev-exposure-check
tools.description: Compare exact dependency versions with OSV advisories and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/software-security/kev-exposure-check Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security advisory, package audit, lockfile audit, dependency check, Cyclone

tools.name: software-security_license-compatibility-check
tools.description: Read licence identifiers declared in the SBOM or published by npm, PyPI, crates.io, or RubyGems, then compare them with the caller allow and deny policy. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/software-security/license-compatibility-check Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security advisory, p

tools.name: software-security_malicious-dependency-check
tools.description: Look for OSV malicious-package advisories and npm compromise heuristics (typosquat distance to popular names, very new packages, few versions, missing repository). Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/software-security/malicious-dependency-check Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security ad

tools.name: software-security_release-precheck
tools.description: Combine exact-version OSV matches, CISA KEV exposure, licence policy, and malicious-package advisories into one release report. Docs: https://www.brainiac.software/api/software-security/release-precheck Keywords: CVE lookup, vulnerability ID, security advisory, package audit, lockfile audit, depende

tools.name: contact_us
tools.description: How to contact BRAINIAC.software support: email, page URL, what to include in a message, and what not to send. Free. Does not send email.
